issues.legal_issue: The Supreme Court may transfer a civil suit to another state when the circumstances create a reasonable apprehension that the ends of justice and public confidence in a fair trial require trial in a calmer atmosphere.
material_facts: A civil suit sought damages and other relief for alleged damage to religious properties and injury to a religious community.
The suit included allegations concerning the participation of public officials and members of the armed forces in a highly sensitive operation.
The Court found that the allegations were likely to arouse strong feelings in sections of the community and that an extraordinary atmosphere prevailed in the state where the suit was pending.
Although the local judiciary was functioning normally, the Court considered that trying the suit in a calmer and quieter atmosphere would better serve the ends of justice.
The Court considered the proposed alternative forum and directed that the suit be tried by a single judge on the original side of a court outside the state where it had been filed.
issues.conclusion: The suit should be transferred outside the state where it was pending and tried in a calmer atmosphere; the Court directed trial in another state's High Court.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 25 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, the Supreme Court's power to transfer a suit between states must be exercised with circumspection and caution, but it should be used when the ends of justice demand it. Justice must not only be done but must be seen to be done, including where the atmosphere may undermine public confidence in the fairness of a trial. The Court relied on G.X. Francis v. Banke Bihari Singh, AIR 1958 SC 309; Hazara Singh Gill v. State of Punjab, [1964] 4 SCR 1; and State of Assam v. Atul Vohra, Transfer Petition No. 21/80.

rule.if: transfer_application_for_civil_suit and sensitive_unusual_dispute and allegations_likely_to_arouse_strong_community_feelings and extraordinary_local_atmosphere and reasonable_apprehension_about_fair_trial and calmer_alternative_forum_available

predicates.transfer_application_for_civil_suit: An applicant seeks transfer of a civil suit from the state in which it is pending.
predicates.sensitive_unusual_dispute: The suit concerns unusual and sensitive allegations involving matters capable of provoking strong public reactions.
predicates.allegations_likely_to_arouse_strong_comm: The allegations concern conduct likely to arouse strong feelings among a section of the community.
predicates.extraordinary_local_atmosphere: An extraordinary atmosphere prevails in the state where the suit is pending.
predicates.reasonable_apprehension_about_fair_trial: The circumstances advanced in support of transfer give rise to a reasonable apprehension that trial in the pending location may impair confidence that justice will be done.
predicates.calmer_alternative_forum_available: A suitable forum outside the affected state offers a calmer atmosphere for trial.
predicates.transfer_suit_outside_affected_state: The suit is transferred for trial outside the state where it was pending.

issues.definition: When a civil suit involves sensitive allegations likely to arouse strong community feelings, an extraordinary local atmosphere gives rise to a reasonable apprehension about a fair trial, and a calmer alternative forum is available, the suit is transferred outside the affected state.
